newsitem.title: USA: Avis Europe to buy back HFS 8.7 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Avis Europe to buy back HFS 8.7 pct stake.

text.p: HFS Inc said Monday that Avis Europe had agreed to buy back HFS's 8.7 percent equity stake in Avis Europe. Terms were not disclosed.
Under the pact, HFS and Avis Europe have entered into a licensing agreement for the use of the Avis name for car rental and leasing business in Asia and Africa.
The transaction is contingent on the completion of the Avis Europe initial public offering and listing on the London Stock Exchange, HFS said.
It also said it would introduce over "the coming months" various cross-marketing programs between Avis Europe and HFS units. It gave no details.
HFS officials were not available for comment.
Avis Europe is the leading car rental company in Europe,
